name: Carbon Based Email Customizer for WooCommerce
author: carbonbasedstudio

sections.description:
Preview customer order emails with a real order, customise branding and copy, and send test emails exactly as customers will receive them.

Features

  • Live preview – Preview a customer order email with a real order.
  • Branding and copy – Change how the email looks and what it says.
  • Test send – Send a test exactly as the customer will receive it.
  • Other plugin content – Previews include content from other plugins, such as licence keys, when the selected order has it.

Requires WooCommerce. Settings are under Carbon Based > Email Customizer.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install this plugin from the WordPress plugins directory, or upload the carbon-based-email-customizer-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. Activate Carbon Based Email Customizer for WooCommerce.
  4. Open Carbon Based > Email Customizer.
sections.faq:
Who is this for?

  • Store owners who want to preview WooCommerce customer emails before they go out.
  • Sites that need to adjust email branding and copy.
  • Stores that want a test send of the finished email.

User guide

Setup, preview, and email branding are covered in the Email Customizer for WooCommerce user guide.
